args.body: generation 2: Generation 1 is short by a factor of 2.6 and the check named both ways out: 180 cm2 of membrane at a jump launch, or 4.8 m/s at the 70 cm2 proposed. The second has a precedent -- Bishop 2006 launched flying squirrels from 4 m, and a 4 m drop is worth about 8.9 m/s before drag -- so this generation stops asking the mouse to jump into flight and lets it fall into a glide. That is a change to the question as much as to the animal, and it is recorded as one.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
